concepts.title: 几何向量与图示运算
concepts.summary: 向量由大小和方向决定；相等向量可平移。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 首尾相接相加；减向量等于加反向量；数乘改变长度，负数反转方向。

pitfalls: 零向量长度为0，没有唯一方向；只有非零向量才有唯一方向角。

en.title: Geometric vectors and graphical operations
en.summary: Magnitude and direction determine a vector; equal vectors may be translated.

method.title: Method
method.body: Add head to tail; subtract by adding the opposite; scalar multiplication rescales length and reverses direction for a negative scalar.

pitfalls: The zero vector has length 0 and no unique direction; a direction angle is unique only for a nonzero vector.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 终点减起点；$\langle a,b\rangle=a\mathbf i+b\mathbf j$；合向量逐分量相加。

method.title: Method
method.body: Subtract initial coordinates from terminal coordinates; $\langle a,b\rangle=a\mathbf i+b\mathbf j$; add components to find a resultant.

concepts.title: 大小与单位向量
concepts.summary: $\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$；非零向量的同向单位向量为$\mathbf v/\|\mathbf v\|$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先求长度，再除以长度；若要求同向长度$L$，乘以$L$。

pitfalls: 不能把零向量除以其长度。

en.title: Magnitude and unit vectors
en.summary: $\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$; for a nonzero vector, $\mathbf v/\|\mathbf v\|$ is its unit vector.

method.title: Method
method.body: Find the magnitude, divide by it, and multiply the unit vector by $L$ when magnitude $L$ is required.

pitfalls: Do not divide the zero vector by its magnitude.

concepts.title: 大小、方向角与分量

method.title: 方法
method.body: 由分量用atan2确定象限，并将方向角规范到$[0,360^\circ)$；由长度和角度算两个分量。

pitfalls: 负的外部系数须反转方向；反正切单独不能确定象限。

en.title: Magnitude, direction angle, and components

method.title: Method
method.body: Use atan2 and the component signs to choose the quadrant, normalize to $[0,360^\circ)$, or compute components from magnitude and angle.

pitfalls: A negative outside coefficient reverses direction; inverse tangent alone does not determine the quadrant.

concepts.title: 力、速度与平衡
concepts.summary: 取东为正x、北为正y；速度或力逐分量相加。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先把方位角转为分量，求合向量；平衡力是合向量的负向量。风从西来表示向东吹。

en.title: Forces, velocities, and equilibrium
en.summary: Take east as positive x and north as positive y; add velocity or force components.

method.title: Method
method.body: Convert bearings to components, add them, and take the negative resultant for an equilibrant. A wind from the west blows east.

concepts.title: 向量几何与点的坐标
concepts.summary: 本知识点来自习题85–100，正文没有对应例题。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用终点减起点表示边；共线向量成比例；平行四边形的对边向量相等，第四顶点有三个可能。

en.title: Vector geometry and coordinates
en.summary: This topic comes from Exercises 85–100; it has no corresponding worked example in the section.

method.title: Method
method.body: Express sides by terminal minus initial coordinates; collinear displacements are proportional; opposite sides of a parallelogram agree and three fourth vertices may be possible.

questions.prompt: 用图6.37中的向量作图：(a) $\mathbf u-2\mathbf w$；(b) $2\mathbf v-\mathbf u+\mathbf w$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a)以图中网格为单位，$\mathbf u=\langle 0, -2\rangle,\mathbf v=\langle 1, 1\rangle,\mathbf w=\langle 1, -1\rangle$；逐分量计算$\mathbf u-2\mathbf w=\langle -2, 0\rangle$。平移箭头首尾相接，作从起点到终点的箭头。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b)以图中网格为单位，$\mathbf u=\langle 0, -2\rangle,\mathbf v=\langle 1, 1\rangle,\mathbf w=\langle 1, -1\rangle$；逐分量计算$2\mathbf v-\mathbf u+\mathbf w=\langle 3, 3\rangle$。平移箭头首尾相接，作从起点到终点的箭头。

en.prompt: Use the vectors $\mathbf u,\mathbf v,\mathbf w$ in Figure 6.37 to graph: (a) $\mathbf u-2\mathbf w$; (b) $2\mathbf v-\mathbf u+\mathbf w$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) In grid units, $\mathbf u=\langle 0, -2\rangle,\mathbf v=\langle 1, 1\rangle,\mathbf w=\langle 1, -1\rangle$. Component arithmetic gives $\mathbf u-2\mathbf w=\langle -2, 0\rangle$. Translate the arrows head to tail and draw the resultant from the initial to final point.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) In grid units, $\mathbf u=\langle 0, -2\rangle,\mathbf v=\langle 1, 1\rangle,\mathbf w=\langle 1, -1\rangle$. Component arithmetic gives $2\mathbf v-\mathbf u+\mathbf w=\langle 3, 3\rangle$. Translate the arrows head to tail and draw the resultant from the initial to final point.

en.label: Example 1

questions.label: 例题 1

questions.prompt: 向量$\mathbf v$的起点为$P(4, -2)$，终点为$Q(-1, 3)$。将其写为位置向量。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\mathbf v=\langle x_2-x_1,y_2-y_1\rangle=\langle -1-(4),3-(-2)\rangle=\langle -5, 5\rangle$。

en.prompt: Let $\mathbf v$ have initial point $P(4, -2)$ and terminal point $Q(-1, 3)$. Write $\mathbf v$ as a position vector.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\mathbf v=\langle x_2-x_1,y_2-y_1\rangle=\langle -1-(4),3-(-2)\rangle=\langle -5, 5\rangle$.

questions.label: 例题 2

questions.prompt: 设$\mathbf v=\langle 2, 3\rangle,\mathbf w=\langle -4, 1\rangle$。求(a) $\mathbf v+\mathbf w$；(b) $-2\mathbf v$；(c) $2\mathbf v-\mathbf w$；(d) $\|2\mathbf v-\mathbf w\|$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) $\mathbf v+\mathbf w=\langle -2, 4\rangle$，对应分量分别计算。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) $-2\mathbf v=\langle -4, -6\rangle$，对应分量分别计算。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (c) $2\mathbf v-\mathbf w=\langle 8, 5\rangle$，对应分量分别计算。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (d) $\|2\mathbf v-\mathbf w\|=\sqrt{(8)^2+(5)^2}=\sqrt{89}$。

en.prompt: Let $\mathbf v=\langle 2, 3\rangle$ and $\mathbf w=\langle -4, 1\rangle$. Find (a) $\mathbf v+\mathbf w$; (b) $-2\mathbf v$; (c) $2\mathbf v-\mathbf w$; (d) $\|2\mathbf v-\mathbf w\|$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) $\mathbf v+\mathbf w=\langle -2, 4\rangle$, calculating corresponding components.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) $-2\mathbf v=\langle -4, -6\rangle$, calculating corresponding components.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (c) $2\mathbf v-\mathbf w=\langle 8, 5\rangle$, calculating corresponding components.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (d) $\|2\mathbf v-\mathbf w\|=\sqrt{(8)^2+(5)^2}=\sqrt{89}$.

en.label: Example 3

questions.label: 例题 3

questions.prompt: 设$\mathbf v=\langle 3, -4\rangle$。(a)求同向单位向量；(b)求长度15的同向向量。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{(3)^2+(-4)^2}=5\ne0$，所以$\mathbf u=\mathbf v/\|\mathbf v\|=\langle \frac{3}{5}, - \frac{4}{5}\rangle$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\|\mathbf u\|^2=\frac{9}{25}+\frac{16}{25}=1$，而除数为正，方向不变。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b)长度15的同向向量是$15\mathbf u=\langle9,-12\rangle$，其长度$\sqrt{81+144}=15$。

en.prompt: Let $\mathbf v=\langle 3, -4\rangle$. (a) Find a unit vector in its direction. (b) Find a vector of magnitude 15 in its direction.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\|\mathbf v\|=\sqrt{(3)^2+(-4)^2}=5\ne0$, so $\mathbf u=\mathbf v/\|\mathbf v\|=\langle \frac{3}{5}, - \frac{4}{5}\rangle$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\|\mathbf u\|^2=\frac{9}{25}+\frac{16}{25}=1$. The positive divisor preserves direction.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The vector of magnitude 15 in that direction is $15\mathbf u=\langle9,-12\rangle$, with magnitude $\sqrt{81+144}=15$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a)以分量计算，$\mathbf u-3\mathbf v=\langle -2, -8\rangle$。

en.prompt: Find (a) $\mathbf u-3\mathbf v$ and (b) $\|\mathbf u-3\mathbf v\|$ for $\mathbf u=4\mathbf i+7\mathbf j$ and $\mathbf v=2\mathbf i+5\mathbf j$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Calculate components: $\mathbf u-3\mathbf v=\langle -2, -8\rangle$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Its magnitude is $\sqrt{(-2)^2+(-8)^2}=2 \sqrt{17}$, taking the nonnegative square root.

steps.title: 计算与推导

questions.label: 例题 6

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 检查长度为$3$，且两分量的符号符合所给角所在象限。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\mathbf v=3(\cos(\frac{\pi}{3})\mathbf i+\sin(\frac{\pi}{3})\mathbf j)=\langle \frac{3}{2}, \frac{3 \sqrt{3}}{2}\rangle$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

questions.label: 例题 7

questions.prompt: 求向北50 lb的力$\mathbf F_1$与向东40 lb的力$\mathbf F_2$之合力的大小和方位。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\mathbf R=40\mathbf i+50\mathbf j$，$\|\mathbf R\|=\sqrt{40^2+50^2}\approx 64.0$ lb。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 方位从北向东量：$\alpha=\tan^{-1}(40/50)$，所以为N 38.7° E。

en.prompt: Find the magnitude and bearing of the resultant of $\mathbf F_1$, a 50 lb force acting northward, and $\mathbf F_2$, a 40 lb force acting eastward.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\mathbf R=40\mathbf i+50\mathbf j$, so $\|\mathbf R\|=\sqrt{40^2+50^2}\approx 64.0$ lb.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Measure the bearing from north toward east: $\alpha=\tan^{-1}(40/50)$, giving N 38.7° E.

questions.label: 例题 8

questions.prompt: F-15战机空速800 mi/h，方位N30°E；风速40 mi/h，吹向S45°E。求地速和地面航向，四舍五入到0.1。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 以未舍入分量求$\|\mathbf r\|$和atan2，得地速790.6 mi/h，方位N 32.8° E。

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use unrounded components for the magnitude and atan2. Ground speed is 790.6 mi/h and the bearing is N 32.8° E.

en.prompt: What single force must be added to the system of forces $\mathbf A,\mathbf B,\mathbf C,\mathbf D$ shown in Figure 6.46 to obtain equilibrium?

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $R_x=1200\cos0^\circ+1000\cos45^\circ+1500\cos150^\circ+600\cos270^\circ\approx608.07$; $R_y=1200\sin0^\circ+1000\sin45^\circ+1500\sin150^\circ+600\sin270^\circ\approx857.11$ lb.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The equilibrant is $-\mathbf R\approx\langle-608.07,-857.11\rangle$ lb, with magnitude about 1051 lb and direction angle about 235.0°. It sums with the resultant to zero.

exercises.prompt: 已知$P(3,5),Q(7,-4)$。用向量求从P到Q的线段上距P为全程$3/4$的点。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\langle4,-9\rangle$。所求点$P+\frac34\overrightarrow{PQ}=(3,5)+(3,-27/4)=(6,-7/4)$。因$0<3/4<1$，点在线段内。

steps.body: $\overrightarrow{PQ}=\langle4,-9\rangle$. The point is $P+\frac34\overrightarrow{PQ}=(3,5)+(3,-27/4)=(6,-7/4)$. Since $0<3/4<1$, it lies on the segment.

en.prompt: Use vectors to find the lengths of the diagonals of the parallelogram determined by $\mathbf i+2\mathbf j$ and $\mathbf i-\mathbf j$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The diagonal vectors are the sum $\langle1,2\rangle+\langle1,-1\rangle=\langle2,1\rangle$ and difference $\langle1,2\rangle-\langle1,-1\rangle=\langle0,3\rangle$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The lengths are $\sqrt{2^2+1^2}=\sqrt5$ and $\sqrt{0^2+3^2}=3$.

en.prompt: Use vectors to find the fourth vertex of a parallelogram with vertices $(0,0),(2,3),(6,4)$. [Hint: There is more than one answer.]

steps.title: Calculate and reason

exercises.prompt: 解释为什么起点相同的两个等价向量，终点必相同。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 等价向量有相同分量v。若公共起点为P，则两个终点都等于P+v；坐标加法给出唯一结果。

en.prompt: Explain why equivalent vectors with the same initial point must have the same terminal point.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Equivalent vectors have identical components v. If their common initial point is P, both terminal points equal P+v, which is a unique coordinate pair.

steps.body: 例如用相同大小、相同方向的力推门。在靠近铰链处推与在门把手处推，力向量等价，但力臂不同，转矩也不同，门转动的效果不同。

en.prompt: Give an example of a physical environment in which two equivalent vectors have different effects.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Push a door with equal forces in the same direction, once near its hinge and once at its handle. The force vectors are equivalent, but their lever arms and torques differ, so they rotate the door differently.

en.answer: Equal forces at different distances from a door hinge produce different torques.
